sandbach.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Sandbach
s1loc: Sandbach builds its calendar around the cobbled Market Square and its ninth-century Saxon Crosses. The Victorian Sandbach Town Hall on High Street stages concerts, comedy and shows, while The Cobbles and Scotch Common host the two-day Sandbach Transport Festival each April, with a main music stand of tribute acts. The Swan and Chequers and Bar Six push live music in the town centre, and the monthly Makers Markets and Charter Market keep the square busy.

And the trade runs at every size here. Major venues, festival operators and production companies across the Cheshire belt field large seasonal crews and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers around Sandbach and Elworth want just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier has to serve the big square festival and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

The deeper trade sits with the people who build the shows. Staging and marquee firms, PA and lighting hire crews, fairground operators and stewarding teams work the Common and the square through the season, and the town's brass-band heritage around Foden's keeps bandstand and concert dates running.
